Project: P10 — LLM Guard and Prompt Injection Defense Platform
Summary: Input scanning and prompt injection detection
Description: Implement injection detection pipeline: (1) rule-based: regex patterns for known injection signatures; (2) LLM classifier: binary classification with confidence; (3) combine: critical if rule match or LLM confidence ≥ 0.9. Log finding. Write audit event.
Business Value: Injection detection is the primary security capability of the guard.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Known injection patterns detected by rule-based layer. 2. LLM classifier detects semantic injection. 3. Verdict: safe/unsafe with findings array. 4. Latency < 100ms for rule-based only path. 5. Unit test: 5 known injection patterns + 3 benign inputs.
Technical Notes: Rule patterns: in domain/detectors/injection_rules.py (versioned). LLM classifier: async (non-blocking for fast path). If only LLM detects: severity=warning. If rule match: severity=critical. See .kiro/specs/project-10/spec.md.
Testing Requirements: Unit: injection detection with fixture inputs (injection + benign). Security: 5 known injection types detected.
Security Requirements: LLM API key in env var. No input content in structured logs.
Definition of Done: Injection detection tested. Human reviewer approved.

Project: P10 — LLM Guard and Prompt Injection Defense Platform
Summary: Output scanning and content validation
Description: Implement output scanner: scan LLM response for PII, secrets, and policy violations. Run PII detector, secret detector, and content policy check in parallel. Aggregate findings. Return verdict with redacted_text (PII redacted from output).
Business Value: Output scanning prevents PII and secrets from reaching end users.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. PII in LLM output detected and redacted. 2. Secret in output detected. 3. Policy violation detected. 3. redacted_text returned with PII replaced by [REDACTED]. 4. Unit test: output with email, API key, benign output.
Technical Notes: PII redaction: replace matched PII with [PII:TYPE] in redacted_text. Secret redaction: replace with [SECRET:TYPE]. Run detectors in parallel with asyncio.gather. Return { safe, findings, redacted_text }.
Testing Requirements: Unit: output scanner with fixture outputs (PII, secret, benign).
Security Requirements: Redacted text returned to caller — original content not stored.
Definition of Done: Output scanner tested. Human reviewer approved.
